channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dario Saric | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dario Saric from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Dario Saric, Cory Joseph
item.description:
Kerr likened the additions of Saric and Joseph to Otto Porter Jr. and Nemanja Bjelica for the 2022 championship season, and even to Zaza Pachulia and David West in previous years.

“We needed guys like Saric and Cory Joseph who have been through the NBA rigors and understand what it means to be a leader from the middle of the roster and how important that is,”

Steve Kerr on Dario Saric, Cory Joseph, Jul 22, 2023. Source: San Jose Mercury-News.

item.title: Devin Booker on Dario Saric
item.description:
Devin Booker on Dario Saric:

“That's my man. A lifelong friend of mine. He always had great energy. Even when he was going through his injury and his rehab, he still brought a high spirit to the gym every single day. ... It was always a bright spot of my day seeing his energy.”

Devin Booker on Dario Saric, Feb 24, 2023. Source: Twitter @KellanOlson.

item.title: Aaron Wiggins on Dario Saric
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Aaron Wiggins on Dario Saric:

“Guys were impressed. He was a funny guy. We were in film and coach was asking him a lot of questionsand he has a great personality and seems like a good guy.”

Aaron Wiggins on Dario Saric, Feb 12, 2023. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: James Jones on Dario Saric
item.description:
James Jones on Dario Saric's timetable after tearing his ACL:

“We just said indefinitely. We're gonna let it play out. He's doing well right now, but until you actually get on the floor and start moving around and actually playing, it's just conjecture.”

James Jones on Dario Saric, Sep 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Cameron Johnson on Dario Saric
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Cam Johnson on Dario Saric:

“It really broke my heart and all of our hearts to hear that. Any time a guy goes down at any point it's terrible, and on top of that, it's the Finals.”

Cameron Johnson on Dario Saric, Jul 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Monty Williams on Dario Saric
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Monty Williams on Dario Saric's ACL injury:

“It's just one of those situations that literally breaks your heart. Dario's a guy that I've been with twice - I coached him in Philly - and to get a chance to be with him here, he's what Suns basketball is about.”

Monty Williams on Dario Saric, Jul 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Monty Williams on Paul Millsap, JaMychal Green, Dario Saric
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Monty on Dario Saric minutes:

“We just felt like Dario gives us a little bit of know-how against JaMychal Green and Paul Millsap.”

Monty Williams on Paul Millsap, JaMychal Green, Dario Saric, Jun 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Monty Williams on Dario Saric
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Monty on Dario Saric's recent struggles:

“He and I had a quick talk yesterday about just play with passion, play with force. Stop thinking about it.”

Monty Williams on Dario Saric, Mar 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Monty Williams on Dario Saric
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Monty on Dario Saric's role:

“You need a connector in each lineup, especially in that second unit...he's the kind of guy that everybody likes playing with.”

Monty Williams on Dario Saric, Dec 17, 2020. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: James Jones on Dario Saric, Aron Baynes, Frank Kaminsky, Cheick Diallo, Deandre Ayton
item.description:
James Jones:

“This year we have from Frank [Kaminsky], Dario [Saric], Cheick [Diallo]...we can play Deandre [Ayton] at power forward if we need to, with Aron Baynes as our center.”

James Jones on Dario Saric, Aron Baynes, Frank Kaminsky, Cheick Diallo, Deandre Ayton, Sep 19, 2019. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Tyus Jones on Dario Saric, Robert Covington
item.description:
Dane Moore:Tyus Jones on playing with Dario Saric and Robert Covington:

“I think it will be great. I love playing with floor spacers.”

Tyus Jones on Dario Saric, Robert Covington, Nov 12, 2018. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Ersan Ilyasova on Dario Saric
item.description:
Jessica Camerato:Ilyasova on Saric:

“He always had potential. He's not just 1 kind of player,he's an all-around player... He still has a lot of room to improve”

Ersan Ilyasova on Dario Saric, Mar 29, 2017. Source: Twitter @JCameratoCSN.

item.title: Brett Brown on Dario Saric
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Brett Brown on Dario Saric:

“When you look at our wins.. the common denominator is that he performs.”

Brett Brown on Dario Saric, Mar 28, 2017. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Brett Brown on Dario Saric
item.description:
Jessica Camerato:Brett Brown on Dario Saric:

“I love coaching Dario. I think that he’s tough, he’s smart, he’s everything that we thought he was going to be”

Brett Brown on Dario Saric, Oct 10, 2016. Source: Twitter @JCameratoCSN.

item.title: Brett Brown on Dario Saric
item.description:
“I ended up sending him a photo of a young kid in the stands with a Saric jersey on, and the response is like what it is, ‘I can’t wait to get [to Philadelphia].’”

Brett Brown on Dario Saric, May 9, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Sam Hinkie on Dario Saric
item.description:
Sam Hinkie on Dario Saric:

“I think he’s very excited to begin his NBA career. We’re in frequent communication with him. It’s not a full-time job, but it’s a part-time job for a lot of us, including me. He’s delayed his NBA career, and I don’t think is going to want to delay it a whole lot longer. He’s one of the best players in the world not playing in the NBA.Most people want to scratch that itch and measure yourself and see where you stack up against the best players in the world.”

Sam Hinkie on Dario Saric, Apr 5, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: DJ Strawberry on Dario Saric
item.description:
David 'Dubi' Pick:Talked to DJ Strawberry on teammate Dario Saric entering NBA draft:

“He needed to go. Too much talent to come back here for another year.”

DJ Strawberry on Dario Saric, Apr 14, 2013. Source: Twitter @IAmDPick.
